name: Dinner with Natsuki
source:
Several months after a fateful summer vacation, married couple Yoshihiko and Natsuki Maeno find themselves out for a romantic night at a fancy hotel. A mishap has them sharing a table with the rich owner of that restaurant, a gentlemanly older man by the name of Tatsuki.

And while the evening promised to be romantic-yet-uneventful, Tatsuki has another plan in mind.

Finding herself sitting next to a man who reminds her so much of her summer affair, will Natsuki be able to endure his advances and remain loyal to Yoshi?

Or will she fall to temptation and accept that after cheating once, the second time is not so hard?

Only one way to find out!

[From [url=https://no-try-studios.itch.io/dinner-with-natsuki-a-king-of-summer-spinoff]itch.io[/url]]
